_comment: Skins dress a room's Collision kind layer at runtime (SkinLayer). tile_tint is required. tileset + terrains map each kind to [terrain_set, terrain] in that TileSet, or to one fixed tile via {"atlas": [source_id, x, y]}. Kinds without a mapping draw as greybox rects so collision is never invisible. 'greybox' must stay tileset-less: it is the permanent fallback, not a placeholder. SSW.tres terrain sets: 2=SSWorlds_SET2 3=SSW_SET3 4=SSW_SET4 5/6=SSW_SET5 8=SSW_SET7 (0,1,7 were SSWorlds_SET1/SSW_SET6, removed); SSW.tres atlas source 9 is the one flat teal water square from SSW2_SET2 build1 (the only flat water tile in any copied sheet). SSW2_SET2.tres (jungle_ruins): terrain set 0 = ground (mossy brick blob, source 0 build1) + platform (wooden plank walkway, source 1 build3); water is atlas tile [0, 10, 25]. No copied pack has spike art, so hazard stays unmapped everywhere (greybox draws it). Sources: assets/tilesets/SOURCES.md.
